id: title:Piccirello:return the posted message from the slack step

review.posthog_relevance: Adds thread-aware message-replying capability to Slack destination workflows, allowing downstream steps to reply in the same thread as a previously posted message rather than creating a new thread.
review.reason: The implementation P1.F2.H1 explicitly returns Slack-specific thread metadata (`channel`, `ts`) from the destination execution, while P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H2 provide the corresponding test and documentation. This establishes a bounded, substantive capability improvement: the Slack destination workflow can now preserve and expose thread context, enabling users to reply in the same Slk
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on downstream workflow steps actually consuming these fields, which is not demonstrated in this chunk; adoption and actual thread-reply behavior are unverified. observations.code_quote: 'Timestamp of the message to reply under. Leave this empty to post a new message. In a workflow triggered by a Slack message, use {event.properties.thread_ts ?? event.properties.ts} to reply under the message that started the run. To reply under a message that an earlier Slack step posted, add an output variable named slack_ts with result path ts to that step, then use {variables.slack_ts}.',
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies that Slack destination steps can expose a thread timestamp, enabling workflows to reply in the same thread as a previously posted Slack message.
